title: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D CPU US$234.08 (~A$332.03) with PayPal Delivered @ Binary Tech Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D CPU US$234.08 (~A$332.03) with PayPal Delivered @ Binary Tech Store AliExpress

[racingmiku] Awesome deal with cashback! With everything pricing up, this wouldnt stay as low for long I think.
[joker0701] Haha ram deals.
The best you can do is buy today, before it goes up tomorrow.
[Jazza2400] Stack some sodimm adaptors and just grab laptop ram from fbmp. The 3d mitigates some of the memory speed being only 5200-5600 (may not get 5600 with adaptors, mine only go to 5200)
[cloudie9] Hopefully my Topcashback UK tracks!
Edit: successfully tracked! £62.33
[beejambie] Can I ask how long it took? An hour? I've only used topcashbak once before for Dell and it never worked, they are doing some 3 month manual reconciliation
edit: well this will teach me for using firefox with tracking protection
[cloudie9] @beejambie: Literally 9mins after purchasing, it got tracked. Yeah you want to disable any ad blocking addon otherwise it won't track.
[UncleRico] Awesome deal.
Such a shame all the AM4 X3D deals were so short lived. Those 5700X3D's from a year or two ago www.ozbargain.com.au/node/869034 are going for more than twice what you could get them for back in the day…
[frondono] I wouldn't be surprised if they come back in stock now they are making the 5800x3d again
[UncleRico] I’m not so sure.
Those anniversary edition 5800X3D’s are going for $500 compared to the OEM 5700X3D’s were little more than $200.
I’m afraid we’ll either be paying too dollar for a 5800X3D or taking the performance hit with the binned 5500X3D’s from here on in.
Oh well, to the swift go the spoils…
[ATangk] The only reason why the prices can stay high is those upgrading on AM4 without needing new RAM. These 7800x3d prices means there is not enough (cheap) DDR5 to support building new systems.
[UncleRico] @ATangk: Yep. The 5800X3D is the best and last upgrade any AM4 owner can get to maximise performance for a few more years on the platform. It’s just a shame it’s so much more than the 5700X3D’s were before they ceased production.
[frondono] i think they'll be selling the chips that weren't suitable to be sold as a 5800x3d as something though. could even be 6 core
[Mrbtree98] the 5500x3d is really the only AM4 X3D cpu left holding the value flag up. I just checked and it's currently $240 aud on aliexpress which isn't terrible but it's also about $30-40 over the cheapest it's been.
[Pulseless] Thinking I might cop the 9800x3d for $500 Aud, seems decent
[buyer-123] Worth upgrading from the ~$230? 7700 deal?
[panda1010101] I got the same deal. 7700 has excellent power efficiency, and gaming performance is slightly behind 7800x3d. I'm waiting for Zen 6 CPUs
[Carteric] I'm not quite sure. Do I need to register for TC UK first? Then place the order on Ali UK?
[Clear] Register on TCB UK and click through. Can change region to Australia if it doesn't automatically on AliExpress and pay as normal.
[Carteric] I successfully got one! Thank you very much!
[Carteric] I'm about to start assembling my new computer. May I ask if there are any other computer accessories that are worth purchasing? For example, SSD? RAM DDR5?
[cosmobro] grabbed one and cashback tracked in ~10minutes
[Caleb9295] To people who say they will wait for RAM deal, none of us can predict the future.
Other components prices go down 'proportionally' to the amount that RAM went up. If RAM go down rn, these parts on sale will rise.
You will end up paying 2k+ anyway.
If you think you can time the components prices, may as well try day trading as a quant trader. See how that goes.
[Jazza2400] Just get laptop ram and adaptors. The 3d mitigates some of the slower ram speed. It's been great for myself playing eft.
[aussieprepper] No need to predict, no future deals until the AI data centres fail.
https://www.tweaktown.com/news/113004/memory-capacity-for-al…
[poiterbad] If it helps anyone buy this, I got this exact CPU from this store the last month's deal. Works great
[DryingPan] Can't seem to click through to Aliexpress UK from the TCB Website. Is this happening to anyone else?
[Clear] It's redirecting to AliExpress just fine. You don't need to go to the AliExpress UK website.
[Te2k] I had the same issue. Worked after I turn off VPN.
[Doy] Cashback didn't seem to track from over an hour ago. Fresh browser, clicked the link to open up Ali, and then followed the OzB link. Hoping I didn't miss anything crucial and I can still claim it 7 days down the track.
Thanks for the deal!
[Craftboy77] showing as 380 for me, paying with usd, PayPal and using the promos, has it finished?
[Te2k] I am pretty sure that's in AUD. Paypal is sneaky. You have to ensure the following:
Click "See currency options"
Select USD to bill the card in USD instead of AUD
Proceed with checkout
Double confirm it is in USD before proceeding.
[flashbang34] Got it for 315.46, then £57.66 (109.72 AUD) in tracked cashback. 315.46-109.72=205.74 AUD
[Shammy111] I got it for AU $319.90, no changing currency or anything, just added the Aliexpress AUNS35 and then the paypal discount after, worked out nicely! Was about to get it for $500 today, so this is perfect!!
Note, I used Aliexpress on my phone if that helps.
[AlphaGamma128] Got it for $319.90.
After 10-15 mins, purchase was tracked by cashback at value of £181.02 ($344.95), for a cashback of £63.64 ($121.27)
Turned off all my adblockers. I used AUNS35 + Paypal discount for $95 off
[Optimistic Goat] I got for $234.08 US, with cashback pending at £62.33. Should work out to $213.22 AUD.
Also bought some RAM from this deal:
https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/971695
Super stoked to build my new PC!
[saurabhgoyal93] Bought for US$234.08 using AUNS20 but in hindsight, should have used AUNS35 to get it for US$15 cheaper!
Unable to place another order, gives the "You've exceeded the maximum purchase quantity for this item." error even though I've bought just 1, the max quantity is 3.
Looks like many are in the same boat as me, the deal needs to be updated to show the AUNS35 code and lower price.
[UncleRico] "Note: If you apply the larger US$35 off coupon AUNS35, then the PayPal discount reduces to US$16. Use the smaller US$20 off coupon above instead."
[Optimistic Goat] Not sure if it changed. I swear I tried the AUNS35 code and it reduced the Paypal discount… but sounds like some people were able to make it work!
